nodes.description: Mapping of contributor address to deposited ether held before token purchase.
Mapping tracking ether received after the token purchase (refunds/late deposits).
Flag indicating the contract has acquired Enjin tokens.
Flag indicating the ERC20 token address has been configured.
Flag indicating Enjin refunded the contributed ether.
Total ether value used for the token purchase, basis for pro-rata payouts.
Emergency flag that halts token purchasing.
Hard-coded sha3 hash compared against a supplied password to activate the kill switch.
Privileged developer address used for access control and fee collection.
Address of the Enjin sale wallet receiving the ether.
Configured ERC20 token contract reference.
Minimum ether balance required before purchasing tokens.
Developer-only function that sets the ERC20 token address.
Developer-only function that toggles the refunded flag.
Enables the kill switch when called by the developer or with the correct password.
Withdraws a caller's ether or pro-rata tokens, taking a 1% fee.
Withdraws using a caller-supplied ERC20 address, taking a 1% fee.
Developer-only function that forwards contract ether to the sale address.
Payable fallback that records deposits and triggers the purchase.
Caller-controlled address used for permissions, balance lookups and transfers.
msg.sender.transfer(...) external ether send inside personal_withdraw/withdraw_token.
sale.call.value(...)() low-level ether forward to the sale address.
token.transfer(...) external ERC20 call to developer and caller.
contract_eth_value -= balances[msg.sender] pro-rata accounting subtraction.
balances[msg.sender] += msg.value deposit accounting addition.
Password argument of activate_kill_switch hashed and compared to password_hash.
_token argument of set_token used to build the ERC20 reference.
_refunded boolean argument of set_refunded.
_token argument of withdraw_token used to build the ERC20 reference.
eth_to_withdraw_after_buy cached balance for post-buy refunds.
eth_to_withdraw cached ether balance to send to the caller.
contract_token_balance token balance held by the contract.
tokens_to_withdraw pro-rata token amount computed for the caller.
fee computed as 1% of the withdrawn token amount.
myToken ERC20 instance built from the caller-supplied token address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against developer to authorize set_token.
msg.sender is checked against developer to authorize set_refunded.
msg.sender together with the password hash gates activate_kill_switch.
msg.sender controls balance lookups and payout destination in personal_withdraw.
msg.sender controls balance lookups and payout destination in withdraw_token.
msg.sender must equal developer to authorize purchase_tokens.
purchase_tokens forwards the contract ether through sale.call.value.
fallback triggers the same sale.call.value purchase flow.
fallback path updates balances through the deposit addition.
sale.call.value executes an external call that can reenter the payable fallback before state settles.
msg.sender.transfer performs an external ether send inside personal_withdraw after state reset.
token.transfer performs an external ERC20 call inside personal_withdraw.
msg.sender determines the recipient of the external ether transfer.
contract_eth_value is used in the pro-rata subtraction accounting.
balances[msg.sender] is subtracted from contract_eth_value.
Deposit addition writes into the balances mapping.
balances[msg.sender] scales the tokens_to_withdraw pro-rata computation.
contract_token_balance is a factor of the tokens_to_withdraw computation.
tokens_to_withdraw is divided by 100 to derive the fee.
Caller-supplied myToken address is used for the external token.transfer calls.
eth_to_withdraw amount is passed to the external msg.sender.transfer.
eth_to_withdraw_after_buy amount is passed to the external msg.sender.transfer.
Supplied password is hashed and compared against password_hash in activate_kill_switch.
_token argument is wrapped into the ERC20 token reference in set_token.
_refunded argument sets the refunded state flag in set_refunded.
_token argument is wrapped into the ERC20 reference in withdraw_token.

normalization_plan.reason: Password parameter belongs to activate_kill_switch and only feeds its hash comparison.
_token parameter is a local argument of set_token with no independent identity.
_refunded parameter is a local argument of set_refunded with no independent identity.
_token parameter is a local argument of withdraw_token with no independent identity.
eth_to_withdraw_after_buy is a cached local value inside personal_withdraw.
eth_to_withdraw is a cached local value inside personal_withdraw.
contract_token_balance is a local intermediate inside personal_withdraw.
tokens_to_withdraw is a computed local intermediate inside personal_withdraw.
fee is a computed local intermediate inside personal_withdraw.
myToken is the local ERC20 instance created inside withdraw_token.
